item.title: LIVE Gustave the Crocodile — The Killer That's Never Been Caught
item.description:
Made with Restream Studio. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io
LIVE: the true story of Gustave — the giant Nile crocodile that has evaded capture for over 30 years and is blamed for some of the deadliest crocodile attacks ever recorded in Africa.
Join this live stream as we break down who Gustave actually is, why he's grown to an estimated 18-20 feet, why scientists and hunters have never been able to catch him, and separate the verified sightings from the legend that's built up around him in Burundi along the Ruzizi River and Lake Tanganyika.
This connects directly to our deep dive on Nile crocodile power here: [LINK TO "Why The Nile Crocodile Just Got 10x Deadlier"] — watch that next for the full picture of what makes this species so formidable.
